title: Children Group Portrait Outdoors, 1940s Vintage Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming vintage sepia snapshot from the 1940s featuring six young children posing together on a grassy lawn. The group includes a small baby held by an older girl, a smiling barefoot girl in the front, and a boy at the top right wearing a bow tie. The background shows an open yard with stacked lumber and rural outbuildings under bright sunlight, capturing a classic moment of mid-century childhood and domestic family life.
